name: HMB Electronics
old_description: We stock brand new and authentic IC’s from the industry’s leading manufacturers such as Analog Devices, TI, Intel, Xilinx, Maxim, and more. In a rush? We offer expedited shipping to get them to you the next day!
about:
HMB Electronics operates from North Haven, Connecticut, as a women-owned small business. The company was established to meet growing demand for expedited shipments of electronic components, leveraging a vast network of suppliers both domestically and internationally to serve customers across the Northeast and beyond.

As a stocking distributor, HMB Electronics carries a broad line of name-brand electronic components including integrated circuits, resistors, transistors, capacitors, connectors, and computer peripherals. The firm maintains a fully equipped warehouse with temperature control, anti-static workbenches, and full-time monitoring to ensure proper handling of sensitive parts. Core services encompass same-day shipping on stocked items, obsolete and end-of-life component sourcing, cross-referencing for alternative parts, excess inventory purchasing, and third-party component testing and verification through a regional facility.

The company serves government agencies, original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), contract manufacturers (CMs), and both franchised and non-franchised distributors. Its customer base spans military, information technology, and general OEM sectors, with components sourced from manufacturers such as Analog Devices, Texas Instruments, Intel, Xilinx, Maxim, and numerous other leading brands.

HMB Electronics differentiates itself through a 110% quality guarantee, AS5553 compliance for counterfeit electronic parts avoidance, and a commitment to providing manufacturer traceability certificates wherever possible. The firm’s partnership with an independent testing facility and its excess inventory purchasing program further reinforce its focus on authenticity and supply-chain reliability.
